mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM supplier_stock a LEFT JOIN org_company company ON company.id = a.company_id LEFT JOIN stuff stuff ON stuff.id = a.stuff_id WHERE a.id > 0 AND a.del_flag = #{delFlag} AND IF(company.is_institution = 0, company.id = #{companyId}, (company.id = #{institution} OR company.id = #{companyId})) AND DATEDIFF(a.end_date, NOW()) <= stuff.indate
